traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.description: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

monsters.name: Zombie
languages: understands languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The rat has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Brute
traits.description: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attack).

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The kobold has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.description: On hit, the stirge attaches to the target and drains 1d4+3 hit points at the start of each of its turns until detached.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.description: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The dire wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The dire wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Rampage
traits.description: When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the gnoll can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.description: The target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

monsters.name: Scout

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.description: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

monsters.multiattack: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

monsters.name: Ghoul
monsters.multiattack: The ghoul makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Rampage
traits.description: When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the hyena can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

monsters.name: Specter
languages: understands languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the specter has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

monsters.name: Spy

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.description: On each of its turns, the spy can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.description: Once per turn, the spy deals an extra 2d6 damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the spy that isn't incapacitated and the spy doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

monsters.multiattack: The spy makes two melee attacks.

monsters.name: Ghast

traits.name: Stench
traits.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the ghast must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

traits.name: Turning Defiance
traits.description: The ghast and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

monsters.multiattack: The ghast makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Gargoyle

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

monsters.multiattack: The gargoyle makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

monsters.name: Minotaur

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 2d8 piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.description: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

monsters.multiattack: The minotaur makes two attacks: one with its greataxe and one with its gore.

monsters.name: Wight

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

monsters.multiattack: The wight makes two longsword attacks or two longbow attacks. It can use its Life Drain in place of one longsword attack.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

monsters.name: Owlbear

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

monsters.multiattack: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

monsters.name: Veteran
monsters.multiattack: The veteran makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

monsters.name: Flameskull

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The flameskull sheds either dim light in a 15-foot radius, or bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. It can switch between the options as an action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The flameskull has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its hit points in 1 hour unless holy water is sprinkled on its remains or a dispel magic or remove curse spell is cast on them.

monsters.multiattack: The flameskull uses Fire Ray twice.

actions.name: Fireball
actions.description: Recharge 5-6. The flameskull casts fireball. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Ettin

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.description: The ettin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.description: When one of the ettin's heads is asleep, its other head is awake.

monsters.multiattack: The ettin makes two attacks: one with its battleaxe and one with its morningstar.

monsters.name: Troll

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

monsters.multiattack: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

monsters.name: Hill Giant
monsters.multiattack: The giant makes two greatclub attacks.

monsters.name: Young White Dragon

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.description: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

monsters.multiattack: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Plus 1d8 cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath
actions.description: Recharge 5-6. The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 10d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Detect
actions.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Wing Attack
actions.description: Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 DEX saving throw or take 2d6+4 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

monsters.name: Young Green Dragon

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

monsters.multiattack: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Plus 2d6 poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath
actions.description: Recharge 5-6. The dragon exhales poisonous gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 12d6 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Detect
actions.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Wing Attack
actions.description: Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 DEX saving throw or take 2d6+4 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

monsters.name: Young Red Dragon
monsters.multiattack: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Plus 1d6 fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: Recharge 5-6. The dragon exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Detect
actions.description: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Wing Attack
actions.description: Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a DC 17 DEX saving throw or take 2d6+6 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

monsters.name: Goblin Archer

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

monsters.description: A goblin trained in ranged combat, preferring to pepper enemies with arrows from a safe distance.

monsters.name: Bandit Crossbowman
monsters.description: A bandit who specializes in crossbow ambushes, keeping their distance while allies engage in melee.

monsters.name: Manticore

traits.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
traits.description: The manticore has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the manticore finishes a long rest.

monsters.multiattack: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
monsters.description: A fearsome winged creature with the body of a lion and a tail bristling with iron spikes it can hurl at prey.

monsters.name: Mage
monsters.multiattack: The mage casts Fire Bolt twice.

actions.name: Fire Bolt
actions.description: Ranged spell attack.

monsters.description: A powerful spellcaster who blasts enemies from range with devastating magical attacks.

monsters.name: Medusa

traits.name: Petrifying Gaze
traits.description: When a creature that can see the medusa's eyes starts its turn within 30 ft. of the medusa, the medusa can force it to make a DC 14 CON saving throw if the medusa isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. On a failure, the creature is restrained until the start of its next turn, and risks being petrified permanently if it fails again while restrained.

monsters.multiattack: The medusa makes either three melee attacks — one with its snake hair and two with its shortsword — or two ranged attacks with its longbow.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.description: Plus 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed DC 14 CON saving throw.

monsters.description: A cursed creature whose gaze can turn living beings to stone. Attacks from range with her longbow while her petrifying gaze affects nearby foes.
